messages.subject: productplots
parts:
I have downloaded Wickham's productplots package from the github site:
https://github.com/hadley/productplots
 
I have saved the .zip file to my desktop and then used the option
"Install package(s) from local zip files…" from the R Package pull down menu to
install the package into my library.  It does not work.  Any suggestions??
 
PS the latest code for productplots is on github not CRAN so downloading from CRAN is
not an option.
 
Thanks

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: productplots
parts:
Hi Vicki,

You can use the devtools package to install from github:

install.packages("devtools")
install_github("productplots")

Best,
Ista
